items: Omnichannel marketing connects every channel where guests find, order from and talk to your restaurant so they get the same experience wherever they reach you.
Unlike multichannel marketing, which manages each channel separately, an omnichannel approach collects customer data in one central place that supports better decisions.
Keep your branding, communication and service consistent online and in store, and engage with guests on every channel so you understand their pain points and behavior.
Use the combined data to personalize offers, run loyalty programs that work for both online and in-store purchases, and target ads more effectively.
